get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit by model name with optional inference settings and device
get_reference_energies: get atomic or form elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace Hub
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a named pretrained model
available_models: list all available pretrained model names loaded from the pretrained_models.json config file
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores filename, repo_id, subfolder, revision, and reference energy fields
